findings.highlight: How can you just lose something that's been built up over generations!?
findings.evidenceJa: なんでたった数時間でなくなる
findings.governingReading: たった数時間 contrasts the treatment duration with generational accumulation.
findings.explanation: The shock at generations of inherited work being consumed in mere hours loses the hours.

findings.highlight: I'd be lying if I said I didn't have doubts.
findings.evidenceJa: 動揺しなかったと言えば嘘になる
findings.governingReading: 動揺 is disturbance from the report; he explicitly has no indecision and has resolved to stand by Sakura.
findings.explanation: Being emotionally shaken becomes having doubts.
